headline: Heavy Fighting Resurges in Weathered Expanse as Island Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, intense base combat has erupted anew across Weathered Expanse, where thirteen strategic base transitions were logged in the past two hours alone amid swirling clashes over Crow's Nest, Frostmarch, and Wightwalk, leaving two installations unoccupied. Stlican Shelf has likewise stirred back into motion with fresh base changes around Breaker Town and rising casualty rates on both sides. Along the far western waterways, Nevish Line recorded tactical shifts near Grief Mother, while Fisherman's Row sustained steady frontline pressure despite casualty numbers cooling considerably. By contrast, the bloody engagements in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County remain locked in violent stalemate; both sectors logged over eight hundred combined casualties in the last two hours without producing any further strategic handovers. Elsewhere across the map, sectors including Linn of Mercy and Palantine Berm have remained quiet, with lines holding firm.
